usage.finalMessage:
I added the reminder fee: 5.00, charged once on an invoice still unpaid more than 30 days after its due date, and counted in outstanding and balance. `run-late-fees` now reports both counts, `show` lists the reminder fee, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (9/9).
Existing tests were updated because both outputs changed; `show` now always prints the reminder fee, even when it is 0.00.
Premium customers are charged the reminder fee, because their late-fee exemption (DEC-B05) hasn't been reviewed by Finance; this and other open questions are in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
